items.title: What took the Internet offline in Q3 2026

sentences.en: What took the Internet offline in Q3 2026.
sentences.zh: 是什么让互联网在2026年第三季度离线。

sentences.en: The Internet can feel invisible when everything is working normally.
sentences.zh: 当一切正常工作时，互联网可能会隐形。

sentences.en: But when connectivity breaks, the many systems it depends upon become evident in an instant.
sentences.zh: 但是，当连接中断时，它所依赖的许多系统瞬间变得明显。

sentences.en: Because Cloudflare’s global network handles more than 20% of the web’s traffic, it offers a unique perspective of how Internet traffic is behaving.
sentences.zh: 由于Cloudflare的全球网络处理超过20 ％的网络流量，因此它为互联网流量的行为提供了独特的视角。

sentences.en: When failures in infrastructure, power, policy, or security disrupt access to the Internet, Cloudflare Radar can observe the impact by monitoring traffic to our customers.
sentences.zh: 当基础设施、电源、政策或安全方面的故障中断对互联网的访问时， Cloudflare Radar可以通过监控客户的流量来观察影响。

sentences.en: Each quarter, we review the disruptions detected and annotated on Radar, highlighting what happened, where it happened, and the broader conditions that shaped each event.
sentences.zh: 每个季度，我们都会审查雷达上检测到的中断情况并进行注释，重点介绍发生了什么、发生在哪里以及影响每个事件的更广泛条件。

sentences.en: In this post, we examine the major categories of Internet disruptions observed during the third quarter of 2026, including government-directed shutdowns, power outages and natural disasters.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们将研究2026年第三季度观察到的互联网中断的主要类别，包括政府定向关闭、停电和自然灾害。

sentences.en: Disruptions at a glance Between July and September, Internet disruptions were largely driven by failures in the systems the Internet depends on.
sentences.zh: 7月至9月期间的中断一目了然，互联网中断主要是由互联网所依赖的系统故障驱动的。

sentences.en: Power grids failed in Cuba, Honduras, Guam, Ukraine, and several other countries.
sentences.zh: 古巴、洪都拉斯、关岛、乌克兰和其他几个国家的电网出现故障。

sentences.en: Natural disasters damaged electricity and telecommunications infrastructure from Nepal to Colombia.
sentences.zh: 自然灾害破坏了从尼泊尔到哥伦比亚的电力和电信基础设施。

sentences.en: Government-directed shutdowns remained the most frequent source of disruption, driven largely by exam-related shutdowns in Iraq, while renewed conflict in Ethiopia’s Tigray region showed how quickly connectivity can become part of a broader political and humanitarian crisis.
sentences.zh: 政府主导的关闭仍然是最常见的中断来源，主要是由伊拉克与考试相关的关闭造成的，而埃塞俄比亚提格雷地区再次发生的冲突表明，连通性很快就会成为更广泛的政治和人道主义危机的一部分。

sentences.en: Outages within the United States, Japan, and Portugal — countries with a relatively strong history of Internet resilience — remind us that no country is immune to disruption.
sentences.zh: 美国、日本和葡萄牙这些互联网复原力相对较强的国家发生的中断提醒我们，没有哪个国家可以幸免于中断。

items.title: Introducing the Cloudflare PHP Capture the Flag challenge

sentences.en: Introducing the Cloudflare PHP Capture the Flag challenge.
sentences.zh: 介绍Cloudflare PHP Capture the Flag挑战。

sentences.en: Last week was one for the Internet security history books.
sentences.zh: 上周是互联网安全历史书籍的一周。

sentences.en: First, eight eMudhra intermediate certificates were compromised , creating the possibility of forged certificates that could be used to impersonate servers.
sentences.zh: 首先，八个eMudhra中间证书被泄露，造成伪造证书的可能性，可用于模拟服务器。

sentences.en: Then came php2shell : serious vulnerabilities in PHP, the runtime behind a large portion of the Web.
sentences.zh: 然后是php2shell ： PHP中的严重漏洞，这是Web大部分背后的运行时。

sentences.en: Cloudflare worked around the clock as these events unfolded to protect our customers and help protect the Internet.
sentences.zh: 随着这些事件的展开， Cloudflare全天候工作，以保护我们的客户并帮助保护互联网。

sentences.en: We shipped client updates and multiple mitigations , updated our web application firewall (WAF) with new rules to block attackers from exploiting the PHP vulnerabilities, and introduced a new feature called full transaction detection .
sentences.zh: 我们发布了客户端更新和多项缓解措施，更新了Web应用程序防火墙(WAF)的新规则，以阻止攻击者利用PHP漏洞，并引入了一项名为完全事务检测的新功能。

sentences.en: As always in situations like this, these new capabilities were made available on all plans, including Free.
sentences.zh: 与往常一样，这些新功能适用于所有计划，包括免费计划。

sentences.en: Put our WAF to the test Protecting systems from vulnerabilities like these is always an ongoing process, not a one-time event.
sentences.zh: 测试我们的WAF保护系统免受此类漏洞的攻击始终是一个持续的过程，而不是一次性的事件。

sentences.en: The widespread adoption of AI allows attackers to discover new vectors with unprecedented speed and efficiency, so collecting real-world data to test our assumptions and strengthen defenses is essential.
sentences.zh: 人工智能的广泛采用使攻击者能够以前所未有的速度和效率发现新的媒介，因此收集真实世界的数据来测试我们的假设和加强防御至关重要。

sentences.en: That’s why today we're launching the Cloudflare PHP Capture the Flag challenge , run through our Bug Bounty program .
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们今天要启动Cloudflare PHP Capture the Flag挑战，通过我们的Bug Bounty计划运行。

sentences.en: We've put a deliberately vulnerable PHP installation behind our WAF, and we're inviting security researchers on HackerOne to try to bypass the protections and capture a flag.
sentences.zh: 我们在WAF后面故意安装了一个易受攻击的PHP ，我们邀请HackerOne上的安全研究人员尝试绕过保护并捕获标记。

sentences.en: How this Capture the Flag (CTF) works We are keeping this simple.
sentences.zh: Capture the Flag （ CTF ）的工作原理我们保持简单。

sentences.en: Sign up here When the US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, visited India for the second time this year, headlines concentrated on who he met and where he went.

items.title: Announcing the Workload Conformance Working Group

sentences.en: Announcing the Workload Conformance Working Group.
sentences.zh: 宣布工作量一致性工作组。

sentences.en: We are excited to announce that the Kubernetes community now has a Workload Conformance Working Group .
sentences.zh: 我们很高兴地宣布， Kubernetes社区现在有一个工作负载一致性工作组。

sentences.en: The working group is writing a shared standard for how workloads behave at runtime on Kubernetes.
sentences.zh: 工作组正在编写Kubernetes运行时工作负载行为的共享标准。

sentences.en: To get it right, we need input from the people who build those workloads and from the people who run the clusters they're deployed on.
Why workloads need a shared standard Certified Kubernetes tests the cluster, and Kubernetes AI Conformance tests whether a cluster can run AI and ML workloads.
Nothing comparable exists for the workloads themselves, so cluster operators still check each application by hand before routine maintenance or a Kubernetes upgrade.
The problems they find are familiar.
A routine node drain is often how you discover that an application can't tolerate disruption.
An upgrade can break an application that still depends on a removed API version .
Others show up in day-to-day operation: workloads that ask for privileges they don't need, or reserve resources they never use.
Kubernetes already documents much of this, including security and handling disruptions .
Even so, every cluster operator ends up repeating the same assessment, and application maintainers get the same questions from each environment they support.

items.title: Cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model, and our remediation with SGLang

sentences.en: Cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model, and our remediation with SGLang.
sentences.zh: 在GLM-5.3 Workers AI模型中交叉请求KV缓存曝光，以及我们对SGLang的修复。

sentences.en: On September 8, 2026, we were alerted by a security researcher, Gadi Evron from Knostic , to a tenant isolation issue affecting the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model ( @cf/zai-org/glm-5.3 ) starting on August 27, 2026.
sentences.zh: 2026年9月8日，来自Knostic的安全研究员Gadi Evron提醒我们，从2026年8月27日开始，租户隔离问题会影响GLM-5.3 Workers AI模型(@ cf/zai-org/glm-5.3)。

sentences.en: We have remediated the issue, and we restored the model on September 9.
sentences.zh: 我们已解决此问题，并于9月9日恢复了模型。

sentences.en: We have confirmed that no other model hosted on Workers AI was affected.
sentences.zh: 我们已确认， Workers AI上托管的任何其他模型均未受到影响。

sentences.en: Between August 27 and September 9, a small number of customers using the GLM 5.3 Workers AI model received responses that contained data from other customers' requests made to the same model shortly before theirs.
sentences.zh: 在8月27日至9月9日期间，少数使用GLM 5.3 Workers AI模型的客户收到了回复，其中包含来自其他客户在他们之前不久向同一模型提出的请求的数据。

sentences.en: In total, 155 responses were affected, all to prompts longer than 681,280 tokens.
sentences.zh: 总共有155个回复受到影响，所有回复的提示长度均超过681,280个令牌。

sentences.en: After excluding our own testing and the researcher's, the requests we identified are consistent in timing and volume with ordinary long-context use, not with someone repeatedly exploiting the bug.
sentences.zh: 在排除了我们自己的测试和研究人员的测试之后，我们确定的请求在时间和数量上与普通的长上下文使用一致，而不是与反复利用该漏洞的人一致。

sentences.en: We found no evidence of deliberate exploitation.
sentences.zh: 我们没有发现故意剥削的证据。

sentences.en: Today we are publishing this report alongside a post from SGLang, the open-source inference engine that we use, as a coordinated disclosure.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将此报告与我们使用的开源推理引擎SGLang的帖子一起发布，作为协调披露。

sentences.en: This post describes the bug that caused this issue, our response timeline, and the subsequent hardening we have conducted on our production SGLang deployments.
sentences.zh: 本文介绍了导致此问题的错误、我们的响应时间表以及我们在生产SGLang部署中进行的后续强化。

sentences.en: We also detail our continued efforts with the upstream maintainers of SGLang to address this and similar bugs.
sentences.zh: 我们还详细介绍了我们与SGLang的上游维护人员一起努力解决此漏洞和类似漏洞。

sentences.en: What happened GLM is a text generation model from Z.ai that is built for agentic coding workflows; it is one of the many models available through Workers AI.
sentences.zh: GLM是Z.ai为代理编码工作流程构建的文本生成模型；它是Workers AI提供的众多模型之一。
